sum: Grande Group Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides corporate finance advisory services in Hong Kong and Chinese Mainland. It offers IPO sponsorship; referral; underwriting, placing, and securities brokerage services; executive training and corporate finance consulting services; and general advisory, independent financial, and compliance advisory services. The company was formerly known as Hero Intelligence Group Limited and changed its name to Grande Group Limited in May 2024. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Admiralty, Hong Kong. Grande Group Limited operates as a subsidiary of Grande Holding Limited.
